# Cully v0.4.2

Fix `cully setup` failing to unpack the matching GitHub release source archive with `multiple roots in Cully source archive`. The CLI now accepts the archive's global PAX metadata header and continues with the normal full-stack setup.

The self-hosting guide clarifies that `cully setup --agent codex` downloads and prepares the stack, starts its services, and connects the agent. `cully setup --prepare` remains available for team deployments that need configuration before services start.

Add `cully uninstall` to stop the local stack and remove managed agent integrations while retaining memory. Use `cully uninstall --purge-data` to also delete local memory volumes and self-hosted configuration. The customer setup runner now verifies the full install, setup, MCP use, and uninstall journey.
